requirements.text: We are opening 'Pune HQ' at 'Tech Park, Building 4', Pune, India, please verify this location exists or create it if missing
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM location WHERE location_id = 'LOC_024' AND name = 'Pune HQ' AND city = 'Pune' AND country = 'India'
assumptions: no location named 'Pune HQ' or in city Pune exists on the seed (the only Indian location is LOC_004 Bangalore Support Center), so the row must be created; id assumed next in sequence (LOC_024 after LOC_023)
'Tech Park, Building 4' is not tested: the schema splits an address into plot_no and street and the request fixes no split
org_id, active and state are not stated by the request and not tested

requirements.text: verify this location exists or create it if missing (boundary: no second Pune HQ)
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM location WHERE location_id <> 'LOC_024' AND name = 'Pune HQ'
assumptions: 'create it if missing' forbids a duplicate: the benchmark check counts rows by name and expects 1, which the id-anchored create above cannot carry, so this stay keeps that strictness

requirements.text: search all other locations in India for 'in_stock' configuration items and immediately transfer them to this new HQ
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_item WHERE configuration_item_id = 'CI_035' AND location_id = 'LOC_024'
assumptions: the only other Indian location on the seed is LOC_004 (Bangalore) and its only in_stock configuration item is CI_035 (serial DEL-CT-5511), so the set is one row, anchored by id
LOC_024 is the id assumed for the new Pune HQ location (next in sequence); the benchmark check resolves it by name
transfer changes location only; status stays in_stock and is not tested

requirements.text: search all other locations in India for 'in_stock' configuration items (boundary: the in_use items at Bangalore stay)
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_item WHERE location_id = 'LOC_004' AND status = 'in_use'
assumptions: a loose reading of 'configuration items in India' would also move CI_023, CI_030 and CI_039, which are in_use at LOC_004 (the only other India location); they must stay

requirements.text: search all other locations in India for 'in_stock' configuration items (boundary: in_stock items outside India stay)
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_item WHERE location_id NOT IN ('LOC_004', 'LOC_024') AND status = 'in_stock'
assumptions: a loose reading of 'in_stock' without the India filter would move the five in_stock items at USA locations (CI_041, CI_042, CI_078, CI_081, CI_088); LOC_024 is excluded so the new in_stock Dell at Pune HQ does not change the count

serial_number and status added beyond the benchmark check: both are stated in the request

requirements.text: create a Knowledge Article titled 'Pune HQ IT Setup' that lists only the serial numbers of these two newly purchased items
